Description
Liverpool Hope ISC is operated by Malvern HE Partnerships, part of Malvern International. We provide international students with the skills and knowledge they need to succeed through university pathway courses, English language courses, young learner programmes, and university services. In partnership with institutions, we help students — and our partners — achieve their goals.
